notes.title: Better Bots Update is LIVE
notes.content:
[h3]Better Bots is all about better Workerbots and efficiency![/h3][p]
Introducing the Better Bots Update[/p][p]We've dedicate several weeks to quality of life improvements and bug fixes and we are now culminating those efforts in the Better Bots Update to showcase it all and shift gears into finalising the next region. [/p][p]
[b]Workerbot Hardpoint Pickup[/b][/p][p]The biggest improvement introduced in this update is the ability to pick Workerbots up onto your Hardpoint. This makes dropping workers up on ledges or down into valley much easier and pairs incredibly well with the Catapults and Crushers. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/28790b729686d445a8ba3133adfb1389a09e6a50.gif"][/img][/p][p]It also makes it possible to flip workers back onto their wheel without the need for a gravity tether. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/2d7502a66ea841873015adc5bb71235f305a414f.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Workerbot Dispatch[/b][/p][p]It is now possible to use the delivery upgrade to dispatch Workerbots. You can hold and drag a line to designate a path for them to follow knowing they will vacuum up chips along the way or you can just request they come to you so that you can pick them up.   [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/f57f56db0caf6d66ab9f9b717e834942951f03ac.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Workerbot Order Assignment[/b][/p][p]Workers now choose orders based on proximity so you will see less of them transiting aimlessly ignoring things right next to them that could have been taken. [/p][p]Workers now also take over jobs from other workers if they became available and are much closer to the task. This makes loading Crushers and Catapults much more efficient as bots don't head back to the shuttle the moment they drop their cargo, but rather look around and see if they can take work from one of their colleagues who is headed here but still far away. [/p][p]We have also improved the loading interactions for the Crane and Catapult and the Crusher has been added to the transit network so now when you happen to block the path to the shuttle when placing the Crusher the workers will still see it as a valid connection and drop resources there correctly. [/p][p][b]
New Equipment - Toolbox[/b][/p][p]We have also added a new piece of equipment for you to bring with you to the asteroid - the Toolbox. This box caries copies of all your Commandbot Tools and allows you to re-configure you bot out in the field the same way you would if you were on the shuttle. Now you can grab a blaster and put away your scanner whenever you need. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/5daacee27511724e725ed8e3c0c79aa9ff618977.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[b]Other Quality of life improvements[/b] [/p][p]We have overhauled the Hardpoint interface to make it easier to load and unload your equipment between the Shuttle and Commandbot  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/5024db7c417fa02244f0594f1831c8bc19fd7bde.gif"][/img][/p][p]The return to station popup now recognises the region you are in chooses the corresponding station as the default, also displaying the distances to the other station choices. [/p][p]The Q Radial now has a BACK option located in the center allowing you to better navigate the radial menus. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/885efc8783f4005a1b810b5b47fd12d9c77cd625.gif"][/img][/p][p]Cube Credit values are now presented in both the Tooltip and Storage view to give you a better idea of the value of each resource you encounter. [/p][p]The asteroids now travel in both directions through your mining claim, not just one like before. [/p][p]We have also added a suite of debug / support options for getting your bots unstuck [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/daa6f82fcf4f419ec2bfd56094b983893878f480.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Daily Deal! Special Bundles! More Cool Games!
[/b][/h3][p]In celebration of the update, starting at 10AM PST on 7/28/2025 we're running a Daily Deal with a [b]discount of[/b] [b]20%[/b]. We have also teamed up with a few of our friends to hold a special "Four Galaxies" sci-fi extravaganza! We're bundling with three other sci-fi games that have major releases today: [i][b]Star Valor[/b][/i] with its new [b]Base Building DLC[/b], [i][b]Reality Break[/b][/i] with its [b]Ascension Update[/b], and last but not least, [i][b]Star Vortex[/b][/i] which is [b]launching today into Early Access[/b]! All games are available bundled with each other for extra discounts, so there's a ton of cool new stuff for you to check out!![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/833360/Star_Valor/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1473060/Reality_Break/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2098160/Star_Vortex/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]What's next?[/b]  [/p][p]We are now shifting gears to focus more on the upcoming Content Update that will take players to the next region with new asteroid classes, a whole new station and new resource types to discover.     [/p][p]Thanks again for following along! Cube Corp wishes you a prosperous day!   [/p][p]-hube[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: Introducing the Better Bots Update
The biggest improvement introduced in this update is the ability to pick Workerbots up onto your Hardpoint.
It also makes possible to flip workers back onto their wheel without the need for a gravity tether.
It is now possible to use the delivery upgrade to dispatch Workerbots.
Workers now choose orders based on proximity so you will see less of them transiting aimlessly ignoring things right next to them that could have been taken.
Workers now also take over jobs from other workers if they became available and are much closer to the task.

We have also improved the loading interactions for the Crane and Catapult and the Crusher has been added to the transit network so now when you happen to block the path to the shuttle when placing the Crusher the workers will still see it as a valid connection and drop resources there correctly.
We have also added a new piece of equipment for you to bring with you to the asteroid - the Toolbox.
We have overhauled the Hardpoint interface to make it easier to load and unload your equipment between the Shuttle and Commandbot
The return to station popup now recognises the region you are in chooses the corresponding station as the default, also displaying the distances to the other station choices.
The Q Radial now has a BACK option located in the center allowing you to better navigate the radial menus.
Cube Credit values are now presented in both the Tooltip and Storage view to give you a better idea of the value of each resource you encounter.
The asteroids now travel in both directions through your mining claim, not just one like before.
We have also added a suite of debug / support options for getting your bots unstuck
In celebration of the update, starting at 10AM PST on 7/28/2025 we're running a Daily Deal with a discount of 20%.
We have also teamed up with a few of our friends to hold a special "Four Galaxies" sci-fi extravaganza!
All games are available bundled with each other for extra discounts, so there's a ton of cool new stuff for you to check out!!
We are now shifting gears to focus more on the upcoming Content Update that will take players to the next region with new asteroid classes, a whole new station and new resource types to discover.

notes.title: Black Tidal Update is Live
notes.content:
[p]We are happy to announce the the Black Tidal update is now live. A whole new region with 4 new asteroid classes, all new resources with a focus on liquids, which can now be harvested using the Liquid Pump. Lets take a look at everything this update has in store!

[b]New Region - New Corporation - New Resources - New Asteroid Classes[/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/7d68c6782b7f57b175e7608ae0104c31e1d3e4d2.gif"][/img][/p][p]As you explore you will encounter some new liquids but beware - some of them may not be so friendly!
[/p][p][b]New Blueprint - The Liquid Pump[/b][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/bd2c0ee18a5fec54aff84e335ded32670ffbe23b.gif"][/img][/p][p]Place it next to any body of water, toss the hose into the liquid and just watch it slowly package up the liquids into nice compact containers ready for transit. Once a liquid body is drained you can start building and exploring the empty basin!
[/p][p]
[b]New Blueprint - The Resource Catapult[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/4611206ee5a9c5ff681d82ba436f9c778bbe5ea3.gif"][/img][/p][p]
This new piece of equipment can help you optimise resource routes, cross chasms and even shoot up hills to get resources out of a gorge. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Level 3 Pirates[/b][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/ee570bb5258e66470af26468ba3f86ee15f73b99.gif"][/img][/p][p]You will now encounter pre-built pirate defences on Asteroids with 💀💀💀 Pirate Activity. Make sure you clear the asteroid before sending your workerbots out![/p][p][/p][p]
[b]New Manufacturing Machine - The Clarifier + Larger Manufacturing Bay[/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/40f421cad22dadf402af9ae30d79f16d2a610c92.gif"][/img][/p][p]You can now operate more machines in various configurations with 4 manufacturing slots and make use of the new Clarifier which can help split certain resources down into two outputs. 


[b]New Command Bot Modifications[/b]
[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,"][tr][th][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/137c79d2c27181401c6ee57eed5274c5d1be1355.png"][/img][/p][/th][th][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/5341aed2282822a3369b7404d2a06abc1c138f11.png"][/img][/p][/th][th][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/794bee102207537b9b49dcf61596be205473723c.png"][/img][/p][/th][th][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/fed1fdc8baecb6b87d731b5034c4732d17834c18.png"][/img][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Heatsink[/b][/p][p]Helps with heat management from Jet Boosters, Mining Lasers and Blasters.[/p][/td][td][p][b]Molten Iron Capacity[/b][/p][p]Increase the amount of molten iron you carry for construction.[/p][/td][td][p][b]Inscrease Scan Range[/b][/p][p]Scan farther to tag resources and detect items buried in the surface rock.[/p][/td][td][p][b]Overclock Speed[/b][/p][p]Ability to move faster on the asteroid surface when tools are unequipped.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]

[b]Ultrawide support[/b]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/f341dfbc26d8eddad978686b3e82c6cde6b12188.png"][/img]
You can now enjoy Astronomics at various aspect ratios and we are no longer locked to 16:9 resolutions![/p][p][/p][p][b]Help / Debug Support Hub[/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/56d24d31cd61db81faf5db9657e1ba19efb386ad.png"][/img]
The Pause Menu now features a new Help / Debug section that can Reset the Command Bot and Astronaut in case they find themselves in some game-breaking location. We also have links to places where you can learn more or report bugs as well as a Command Line Console where we have some commands that will help us gather data or make fixes if problems arise. 


Congratulations! you made it to the end of this message! We hope you enjoy the update. Thanks for joining us on this Early Access ride. Our plans are now to spend several weeks polishing things up, improving quality of life and fixing some pain points before we switch gears into finishing up the next region. 

As always Cube Corp wishes you a prosperous day!
[/p][p]-hube[/p]

notes.title: May Update - Black Tidal Region
notes.content:
[b]Second Content Update[/b]

The Black Tidal Update is here - we have a new region! This Cube Corp subsidiary is focused on liquid resources which you will find in abundance on asteroids in the new region. 

[list]
[*] Liquid Pump Blueprint
[*] Resource Catapult Blueprint
[*] Command Bot Modifications
[*] New Region, New Station, New Asteroids
[*] LIQUIDS
[/list]

Liquid pools have gone through an overhaul. On top of visual updates liquids will impact your speed, change the audio and some will have interesting properties for you to discover. The new Liquid Pump will allow you to package these up for transit. The new Resource Catapult will help with logistics on the Asteroid.

There are also new modifications for you to purchase for your Command Bot which will improve Molten Iron carrying capacity, heat cooldown and speed. 

The Manufacturing Bay, which can now be expanded to 4 slots, is getting a new piece of machinery. There are also several new recipes in the existing machines that have been added. 

Official news post with some images detailing the update will go up later today! 

Cube Corp wishes you a prosperous day!

notes.title: Version 0.74.7 - Manufacturing Multiplier
notes.content:
Hello! 

Today I arrive with a small fix to the Manufacturing pains that have been reported. We have heard your feedback on the manufacturing and we are working towards a more interesting manufacturing future, one that has more optimizations, options and requires less planning. For the time being we hope this solution offers some reprieve. 

You can now go to Settings -> Gameplay and set a multiplier for Manufacture Time from 1 to 10x decreasing the time it takes for machines to process any recipe up to ten times.

Hopefully this improves the experience for now, until we can offer something more interesting and balanced. 

Cube Corp wishes you a prosperous day!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hello! We have entered May and are working hard to get the Black Tidal region for you all this month! 

FIrst lets do a rundown of the news

[b]The Roadmap has been updated[/b]
You can check that out [url=https://astronomicsgame.com/roadmap/]here[/url]

[b]We're launching an Astronomics Wiki on wiki.gg[/b]
Efforts spearheaded by Alikimoko and a group of great folks he has gathered are about to yield some incredible results as we welcome the official Astronomics wiki. It has been a tremendous endeavour and we've been helping as best we can. Thank you to everyone who contributed to this effort, the folks at wiki.gg and especially to Alikimoko who has done the bulk of the heavy lifting. Very exciting to see this go live sometime in May. 

[b]March Update Launched last month[/b]
The post about the March update never got more than some patch notes so here's a rundown of some of the new equipment that has been introduced to the game at the end of March!

[b]The Gravity Well[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/ac44310747bfee4da0f459abbb51caa895517a4f.gif[/img]
A contraption that lets you feed matter into a tiny black hole to then exert a counter force to the asteroid causing it to stop and give you more time to mine resources!

[b]The Forcefield[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/8f7fb5df8a54966e6930cc125691383dd1160788.gif[/img]
A portable piece of equipment that produces a defensive shield that will block pirate bullets and prevent pirate pods from landing inside! But beware, the pirates can still walk in, just like you and the workerbots can. 

[b]The Portable Battery[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/b884e2e9f8cc68992a52867e862eba8090679fa8.gif[/img]
A portable battery that allows you to charge out in the field. Great when paired with the workerbot delivery system. Forget going back to the shuttle - take some extra juice with you. 

[b]The Black Tidal Update[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/28ec0ded6b08c9b4e4f32f669023ac04d88b2d81.gif[/img]

We are still working to address some of the more urgent bugs you have reported, and improve the Manufacturing experience before this update goes out - look for those in the coming days.

notes.title: Version 0.73.13 - Gem Balancing
notes.content:
The correction to Gem Deposits is now followed up with some balancing to Uncracked Gem values as the fix did cause some economic disruption. Resin also has been rebalanced as the change to Undesirable valuation had disrupted it. 

[list]
[*] Resin recipe revised output more resin to reflect increase biomass value from 50 → 5 to 50 → 15.
[*] Upgrades requiring Resin have had their requirements increased. Fuel upgrade from 100 → 300 and Forge Level 2 from 300 → 500 (which lowers the resin cost on Forge).
[*] All cracked gems have had their Earth Dollar value increased to be 1/20th of the Flawless Gem Value and have been made Uncommon increasing the earned from them Cube Credits.
[*] Gem Dust value has been increased to match from $600 to $1350 and also set to be Uncommon.
[*] Fiber Optic Strands increased to $2500/kg and classified as Rare.
[*] Improved unloading distance on shuttle equipment door to help with turret pickup during delivery orders.
[/list]

CUBE CORP wishes you a prosperous day
-hube

notes.title: Astronomics Extended Demo is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h2][b]The demo has been extended![/b][/h2]
Thank you for playing our demo over the last three weeks and sending us all of your thoughts and comments. We have assembled an extended version of the demo for you to try.

+ Unlocked Freighter Fuel Upgrade - more jumps into the belt on one shift
+ Unlocked blueprints - new construction options
+ Unlocked upgrades - Jet Booster and Improved Gravity Tether for your bot
+ Improved tagging system for smoother resource gathering

[previewyoutube=C-_HJBsycrY;full]https://youtu.be/C-_HJBsycrY[/previewyoutube]

All this and more is covered in this video showcasing the changes we have made in the last three weeks. We hope you enjoy and we look forward to seeing you out in the asteroid belt.
